teaser: Policy as code answers one question. An agent behaviour policy holds the rest, and can be generated into code or reverse engineered from it.
core_idea: Policy as code answers whether a request is allowed, while an Agent Behaviour Policy holds the reach, the mandate and its reasons, the gap, the unencodable rows, the owner and who can change each rule's code; with those columns a policy can be generated into engine code and reverse engineered from code, spreadsheets and paper, and fractal semantic graphs connect the altitudes so the gaps in both directions become queries.

nodes.label: Policy as code
nodes.summary: Rules decoupled from services, declarative, returning structured decisions.

nodes.label: One question: is this allowed?
nodes.summary: The engine decides requests routed through it; governance asks about everything around them.

nodes.label: What an ABP adds
nodes.summary: Reach, mandate with reasons, gap, unencodable rows, owner, and who can change the code.

nodes.label: Who can change the code
nodes.summary: A rule the agent can rewrite is a setting, not a boundary.

nodes.label: This session, reverse engineered
nodes.summary: Eleven rules, eight with code, one boundary: the GitHub scope.

nodes.label: Reasons hide in comments
nodes.summary: The validator carries why each rule exists in its comments: the paper policy, scattered.

nodes.label: ABP rows to Rego
nodes.summary: Five rows generated into a 35-line policy that OPA ran against seven requests.

nodes.label: Deny, ask, allow, with the row
nodes.summary: Three denied, one asked, three allowed; each decision names its row.

nodes.label: Rego back to rows
nodes.summary: opa parse and a diff: a row with no code, a rule with no row.

nodes.label: Spreadsheets and paper
nodes.summary: A control CSV became a graph joined to the Act; a role file renders as a page and a check.

nodes.label: Fractal semantic graphs
nodes.summary: Each altitude keeps its vocabulary; edges carry verbs both ways; gaps become queries.

nodes.label: Enabler, scaling, enforcer, decision-maker
nodes.summary: With an ABP as the source, each of policy as code's jobs gets sharper.
